title: qbee SSH key management can follow symlinks into privileged files
summary: The privileged file helper follows attacker-controlled symlinks. A local account managed by the SSH Keys bundle can redirect provisioned keys into the root account key file. Other paths permit overwrite or ownership changes under additional conditions.

severity.rationale: This is local privilege escalation through SSH configuration management. A managed local account and a later privileged configuration application are required.

affected.note: The advisory recommends release 2026.27 or later. Its Go package fix is 0.0.0-20260615134032-0fdf8e411de5.

exposure: The primary path requires an untrusted local account whose SSH keys are managed by the bundle. Kernel protected_symlinks does not block that home-directory path.

params.instructions: Check qbee-agent version, affected release line and the documented exposure conditions.

remediation.action: Update or contain the affected component
remediation.details: Upgrade to qbee-agent 2026.27 or later. Temporarily disable the SSH Keys bundle for untrusted accounts if upgrading is delayed.
remediation.risk: Medium. Updates can interrupt workflows and require compatibility checks.

verification: Confirm the deployed release meets the corresponding fixed version and verify the affected workflow with harmless test inputs.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.
